decisions.reason: A spring-controlled flap weir is close to the firm's core water-control equipment, and keeping a basic website mention costs little while demand uncertainty remains high.

An energy management system for water facilities is farther from the firm's mechanical core and likely requires ongoing support, so its option value is lower and the cost of keeping it is higher unless it shows traction.

An overflow flap gate for water level regulation has its own webpage and fits the firm's established water-control expertise, suggesting lower uncertainty and stronger prospects, so the option is worth keeping.
